Estimates for the items on the plate (the blueberries and juice are separate from the plate, so I counted only the plate's contents):

- English muffin with cheese: about 150 kcal, 90 g
- Toast, one thick slice: about 130 kcal, 50 g
- Roasted tomato half: about 15 kcal, 50 g
- Egg (poached or soft-cooked): about 75 kcal, 50 g

That comes to about 370 kcal and 240 g. The muffin may also have egg or bacon inside, so I rounded up slightly.
